project_description.value: Title II A&E services for the construction of new Building 6-28A (Dynamometer Building), a ~10,000 SF steel pre-fabricated building at Harvey Point Defense Testing Activity (HPDTA), Hertford, NC. The original project design was completed in May 2017; the engineering firm of record subsequently ceased operations. BFA was engaged to review and update the existing design package, issue stamped/certified AFC drawings and specifications, and provide full construction-phase Title II services including submittal review, periodic site inspections, and building commissioning oversight.
project_description.quote: The purpose of this project is to provide professional Architectural and Engineering (A&E) services (Title II Services) for the construction of a new building.

bfa_scope_description.value: Prime A&E consultant for Title II services: (1) review and update existing 2017 design package incorporating government-directed changes across civil, architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, life safety, fire safety, IT/communications, and intrusion alarm systems; (2) issue 100% design package and AFC stamped/certified drawings; (3) pre-bid clarifications; (4) post-award submittal review and approval; (5) periodic discipline-specific site inspections; (6) building commissioning oversight; (7) as-built drawing preparation. BFA served as engineer of record replacing the defunct original design firm.
bfa_scope_description.quote: The selected A&E firm shall perform as the engineer of record and issue drawings, specifications and other documents for a complete design package allowing the Government to utilize for a competitive construction solicitation.

conflict_flags.rationale: The Mechanical Equipment Log is a March 2023 submittal dated after the November 2022 SOW. It is explicitly titled a 'Change Log' documenting equipment selection changes. The Addison unit replaces the originally specified Valent unit. Minor severity because both sources are internally consistent with a documented substitution process during design development.

claims.value: full and open competition per FAR Part 6

conflict_flags.rationale: ITB §9 states award normally to 'lowest responsible bidders complying with requirements.' FAR Part 6 governs the competition basis (full and open), while award basis is lowest responsible bidder. Both claims are consistent — full and open competition with low-bid award basis.
